scan_target.focus: HIGH/CRITICAL complete attack chains: xt_compat, AF_PACKET TPACKET_V3, iSCSI netlink, TIPC MSG_CRYPTO, n_gsm/6pack (plus prior io_uring findings)

findings.title: io_uring async workers run with kworker credentials (CVE-2019-19241)
findings.description: On this 5.4-rc3 tree, io_uring has no ctx->creds / override_creds path. Async submission (io_sq_wq_submit_work), SQPOLL (io_sq_thread), and poll completion work execute under the kernel worker/kthread credentials (UID 0, full capabilities) instead of the submitting task's creds. IORING_OP_SENDMSG is forwarded to __sys_sendmsg_sock from that context. Fixed upstream by 181e448d8709 (landed in 5.4.2); this rc still lacks any cred inheritance.
findings.impact: Unprivileged local attacker can escalate effective privilege for operations that authorize via current credentials (e.g. netlink/UID-sensitive paths, FUSE request headers), achieving privilege-restriction bypass / LPE (NVD CVSS 7.8).
findings.attack_path:
1. Unprivileged process calls io_uring_setup (no CAP required for basic rings).
2. Submit IORING_OP_SENDMSG that blocks/fails with -EAGAIN so __io_queue_sqe punts to io_sq_wq_submit_work on a kernel workqueue.
3. Worker runs __io_submit_sqe → io_sendmsg → __sys_sendmsg_sock with kworker creds (UID 0 / full caps).
4. Crafted sendmsg (e.g. netlink) observes elevated current credentials and bypasses intended user restrictions.
findings.remediation: Apply 181e448d8709 / 0b8c0ec7eedc (capture submitter creds at io_uring_create; override_creds in io_sq_wq_submit_work, io_sq_thread, and poll completion). Or upgrade to >= 5.4.2. Mitigate by restricting io_uring via seccomp/LSMs if backport is unavailable.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC not recorded in this run. Vulnerability confirmed by absence of any cred/override_creds symbols in fs/io_uring.c and by NVD scope (kernels < 5.4.2).

findings.title: io_uring poll ignores POLLFREE → UAF on signalfd/binder waitqueues (CVE-2022-3176)
findings.description: IORING_OP_POLL attaches io_poll_wake to file waitqueues. signalfd_cleanup and binder_thread_release emit wake_up_poll(..., EPOLLHUP|POLLFREE) before freeing task-lifetime waitqueues. io_poll_wake never special-cases POLLFREE: after list_del it may complete inline or queue io_poll_complete_work, which can vfs_poll/add_wait_queue on poll->head after the queue is freed. Stable fix fc78b2fc21f10 disables polling FMODE_BUF_RASYNC/pollfree files; that guard is absent here (5.1–5.4.211 affected).
findings.impact: Unprivileged local attacker obtains a use-after-free on a wait_queue_head_t via io_uring POLL + signalfd (or binder on Android). Exploitable for kernel memory corruption / LPE (NVD CVSS 7.8).
findings.attack_path:
1. Create signalfd and an io_uring instance; submit IORING_OP_POLL on the signalfd.
2. io_poll_add → vfs_poll → add_wait_queue(&sighand->signalfd_wqh, &poll->wait).
3. Exit/exec or otherwise trigger signalfd_cleanup → wake_up_poll(EPOLLHUP|POLLFREE) then free/reuse the sighand waitqueue.
4. io_poll_wake does not treat POLLFREE as teardown-only; async completion path may touch freed poll->head (UAF).
findings.remediation: Backport fc78b2fc21f10 (mark signalfd/binder FMODE_BUF_RASYNC / refuse io_uring poll on pollfree files) or implement proper POLLFREE handling in io_poll_wake. Upgrade past 5.4.212 on the 5.4 stable line.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC not recorded. POLLFREE string absent from fs/io_uring.c; wake path and signalfd_cleanup POLLFREE emitter verified in-tree.

findings.title: xtables COMPAT IPT_SO_SET_REPLACE heap overflow (CVE-2021-22555 class)
findings.description: CONFIG_COMPAT path translate_compat_table → compat_copy_entry_from_user → xt_compat_{match,target}_from_user converts 32-bit rule blobs into a native table allocated from a size computed only from xt_compat_*_offset deltas. xt_compat_target_from_user copies using the user-supplied target_size, then memset-pads to XT_ALIGN(kernel targetsize) and advances *dstptr by user_size+off — before translate_table/xt_check_target ever validates that the user object size matches the kernel target. Combined with COMPAT_XT_ALIGN vs XT_ALIGN slack in next_offset/target_offset, the second pass writes past the kvmalloc'd table (classic 4-byte+ heap OOB write). Setsockopt gate is ns_capable(sock_net(sk)->user_ns, CAP_NET_ADMIN), not init_user_ns.
findings.impact: Local privilege escalation to root via heap corruption (msg_msg/pipe-buffer style primitives). Public exploits exist for this exact class. CVSS 8.3–8.9 range (NVD HIGH/CRITICAL depending on scoring).
findings.attack_path:
1. Requires CONFIG_COMPAT + IA32_EMULATION (typical x86_64 distro) and CONFIG_USER_NS (distro-enabled; Kconfig default n).
2. Unprivileged user: clone(CLONE_NEWUSER|CLONE_NEWNET), map uid 0, obtain CAP_NET_ADMIN in the new user_ns (ns_capable check in do_ipt_set_ctl/compat_do_ipt_set_ctl).
3. From a 32-bit process (or compat setsockopt), craft IPT_SO_SET_REPLACE / IP6T_SO_SET_REPLACE / ARPT_SO_SET_REPLACE blob with malicious target_offset/next_offset/padding.
4. Kernel allocate-undersized xt_table_info, overflow during compat_copy_entry_from_user / xt_compat_target_from_user, escalate via heap primitives.
evidence: net/netfilter/x_tables.c:801-846 (xt_compat_check_entry_offsets — no user_size vs kernel targetsize check)
net/ipv4/netfilter/ip_tables.c:1390-1465 (translate_compat_table allocates then copies before native validate)
findings.remediation: Backport the CVE-2021-22555 fixes (strict size/offset validation before compat copy; ensure allocated native size covers XT_ALIGN padding). Or upgrade past fixed 5.4.stable / 5.10.41 / 5.12.8. Temporary mitigations: disable unprivileged user namespaces; restrict 32-bit/compat; drop CONFIG_COMPAT if unused.
findings.poc_video_notes: Not executed in-VM. Overflow math and missing pre-copy size checks verified in-tree; public BFS/Google exploit targets this code shape.

findings.title: AF_PACKET TPACKET_V3 macoff/netoff u16 overflow (CVE-2020-14386 class)
findings.description: tpacket_rcv declares macoff/netoff as unsigned short. PACKET_RESERVE accepts any value <= INT_MAX with no upper bound relative to frame geometry. netoff = TPACKET_ALIGN(tp_hdrlen[+maclen]) + tp_reserve [+ virtio_net_hdr] is truncated on assignment; when the full sum exceeds 0xffff, macoff wraps (including unsigned underflow when truncated netoff < maclen). With PACKET_VNET_HDR, virtio_net_hdr_from_skb writes to h.raw + macoff - sizeof(virtio_net_hdr), which can be before the frame when macoff < 10 after wrap. skb_copy_bits then copies snaplen bytes at the corrupted macoff. Ring setup only enforces frame/block >= tp_hdrlen+tp_reserve (unsigned int), so large reserve still installs a ring.
findings.impact: Unprivileged local heap overflow → reliable LPE (public exploits). NVD CVSS 7.8 HIGH; treated as CRITICAL here due to complete unprivileged userns+netns chain.
findings.attack_path:
1. CONFIG_USER_NS + CONFIG_PACKET (standard). clone(CLONE_NEWUSER|CLONE_NEWNET); map uid 0 → CAP_NET_RAW via ns_capable in packet_create.
2. socket(AF_PACKET, SOCK_RAW, …); setsockopt(PACKET_VERSION, TPACKET_V3); setsockopt(PACKET_VNET_HDR, 1); setsockopt(PACKET_RESERVE, value causing netoff > 0xffff).
3. setsockopt(PACKET_RX_RING) with block_size >= tp_hdrlen+reserve.
4. Inject/receive a frame (loopback/PACKET_OUTGOING). tpacket_rcv truncates macoff/netoff and writes OOB (vnet header and/or packet payload) into adjacent kernel heap.
findings.remediation: Widen macoff/netoff to unsigned int (upstream fix for CVE-2020-14386); bound tp_reserve so netoff cannot exceed frame/block geometry; refuse combinations with PACKET_VNET_HDR that make macoff < sizeof(virtio_net_hdr). Upgrade to fixed 5.4.stable / >= 5.8.1.
findings.poc_video_notes: Arithmetic for u16 wrap + vnet underflow (macoff < 10 ⇒ write before frame) verified against this source. Full LPE PoC not run in this environment.

findings.title: iSCSI NETLINK_ISCSI unbounded attrs: heap overflow + OOB read + pointer leak (CVE-2021-27365/27364/27363)
findings.description: NETLINK_ISCSI is registered on init_net without NL_CFG_F_NONROOT_* flags, but netlink_sendmsg only enforces CAP_NET_ADMIN when dst_portid/dst_group are non-zero — sends to the kernel (pid 0) are allowed for any local user. iscsi_if_recv_msg has no capable() check. iscsi_if_rx only checks nlmsg_len >= sizeof(uevent); it never validates set_param.len / send_pdu.hdr_size/data_size against remaining payload (OOB read, CVE-2021-27364). String params go through iscsi_switch_str_param → kstrdup without a PAGE_SIZE cap; sysfs show paths then sprintf("%s\n", …) into a PAGE_SIZE buffer (heap overflow, CVE-2021-27365). show_transport_handle is S_IRUGO and sprintf's the kernel transport pointer (CVE-2021-27363), also supplying the handle needed for netlink messages.
findings.impact: Unprivileged local user: kernel pointer leak, kernel OOB read, and PAGE_SIZE heap overflow via sysfs show after planting a long string — DoS or LPE when transport module is loaded (scsi_transport_iscsi / iscsi_tcp).
findings.attack_path:
1. Prerequisites: scsi_transport_iscsi loaded (common when open-iscsi stack present). No user/net ns required — works in init_net as normal UID.
2. Read /sys/class/iscsi_transport/*/handle (world-readable) → kernel pointer + transport_handle.
3. socket(AF_NETLINK, SOCK_RAW, NETLINK_ISCSI); send ISCSI_UEVENT_CREATE_SESSION / CREATE_CONN / SET_PARAM with transport_handle (dst pid 0 bypasses netlink CAP check).
4a. SET_PARAM string field longer than PAGE_SIZE → kstrdup stores it; later sysfs read → sprintf overflow (27365).
4b. SET_PARAM/SEND_PDU with len/hdr_size/data_size past nlmsg end → OOB read (27364).
evidence: drivers/scsi/scsi_transport_iscsi.c:3674-3716 (iscsi_if_rx length check only covers uevent header)
net/netlink/af_netlink.c:1861-1872 (CAP check skipped when dst_portid==0 && dst_group==0)
findings.remediation: Backport CVE-2021-27363/64/65: restrict handle sysfs; validate all netlink payload lengths against nlmsg_len; cap string params to PAGE_SIZE-1 and use snprintf in show methods; require CAP_SYS_ADMIN (or netlink_capable) in iscsi_if_recv_msg. Unload iscsi transport modules if unused.
findings.poc_video_notes: Control-flow and missing length/cap checks verified in source. Exploitability requires a registered iscsi_transport (module present).

findings.title: 6pack decode_data unbounded cooked_buf heap overflow
findings.description: decode_data appends three bytes to cooked_buf[400] via rx_count_cooked++ with no upper bound. sixpack_decode feeds decode_data for every non-command byte while SIXP_RX_DCD_MASK is set (attacker sets DCD via a priority command byte). A userspace writer on a tty with N_6PACK ldisc can flood data bytes without SEOF and overrun the kmalloc'd struct sixpack cooked_buf into adjacent heap. tiocsetd has no CAP_SYS_ADMIN gate in this tree; a PTY + TIOCSETD(N_6PACK) is sufficient when the 6pack module is available (autoload or preloaded).
findings.impact: Local kernel heap overflow from an unprivileged tty writer → DoS or LPE when CONFIG_SIXPACK is enabled/loadable.
findings.attack_path:
1. Open a PTY pair (unprivileged).
2. ioctl(TIOCSETD, N_6PACK) on the slave (no capability check in tiocsetd; module autoload if CONFIG_LDISC_AUTOLOAD).
3. Write a 6pack priority command that sets SIXP_RX_DCD_MASK.
4. Write >400 payload data bytes without SIXP_SEOF → decode_data overflows cooked_buf[400].
evidence: drivers/net/hamradio/6pack.c:951-969 (sixpack_decode calls decode_data while DCD set)
findings.remediation: Reject decode_data when rx_count_cooked would exceed sizeof(cooked_buf)-3; reset state on overflow. Consider requiring CAP_SYS_ADMIN to attach N_6PACK. Disable/unload 6pack if unused.
findings.poc_video_notes: Bounds absence and DCD-gated path verified in source. Not runtime-exploited in this run (module may be modular).

rejected.title: eBPF ALU32 missing u32 bounds / CVE-2021-3490 class
rejected.reason: bpf_reg_state has only s64/u64 bounds (no u32_min/max). Explicit ALU32 bounds tracking (3f50f132d840) and CVE-2021-3490 were introduced in 5.7-rc1 — not in 5.4-rc3. Missing fields here are pre-feature, not that CVE.

rejected.title: CVE-2020-8835 JMP32 bounds masking
rejected.reason: __reg_bound_offset32 absent. Introducing commit 581738a681b6 is v5.5; 5.4-stable only gained it at 5.4.7. This rc is not affected.

rejected.title: CVE-2020-27194 / CVE-2021-31440 32-bit truncation class
rejected.reason: Depends on scalar32_* bounds helpers from the 5.7+ ALU32 tracking era; not present in this tree.

rejected.title: CVE-2022-23222 PTR_TO_MEM vs SCALAR confusion
rejected.reason: Later verifier class; 5.4-rc3 reg types lack the PTR_TO_MEM register-state variant used by that bug.

rejected.title: CVE-2023-2163 verifier pruning / precision taints
rejected.reason: Precision tracking (b5dc0163d8fd) exists and the imprecise-scalar prune shortcut in regsafe() is present, but unprivileged paths force precise=true on unknown regs (allow_ptr_leaks=false). Ubuntu/Google: exploitation needs CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_BPF. Rejected under unprivileged-only criteria.

rejected.title: CVE-2019-2215 binder epoll UAF
rejected.reason: FIXED in this tree: binder_thread_release emits wake_up_poll(EPOLLHUP|POLLFREE) and synchronize_rcu() (commits f5cb779ba163 / 5eeb2ca02a2f).

rejected.title: CVE-2021-26708 vsock multi-transport race
rejected.reason: 5.4-rc3 uses a single global transport pointer; vsock_assign_transport / per-socket transport swap arrived in 5.5-rc1. Not vulnerable.

rejected.title: io_uring SQPOLL privilege escape
rejected.reason: IORING_SETUP_SQPOLL correctly requires capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN) at fs/io_uring.c:3120-3123.

rejected.title: TIPC MSG_CRYPTO / CVE-2021-43267
rejected.reason: MSG_CRYPTO, tipc_crypto, and aead_key netlink paths are absent under net/tipc/ in 5.4-rc3. That feature landed in later kernels (~5.10+). Not vulnerable to CVE-2021-43267.

rejected.title: n_gsm line-discipline decoder HIGH LPE
rejected.reason: gsm0_receive bounds gsm->len against mru before GSM_DATA; gsm1_receive stops at count > mru with OVERRUN. buf is kmalloc(MAX_MRU+1). No complete unprivileged HIGH overflow chain verified in this rc comparable to the named CVE classes. Residual locking/UAF classes exist in later CVEs but were not confirmed as complete attack chains here.

rejected.title: xtables / AF_PACKET requiring CAP_NET_ADMIN in init_user_ns only
rejected.reason: Rejected as a dismiss path: both use ns_capable(net->user_ns, …). With CONFIG_USER_NS, unprivileged CLONE_NEWUSER|CLONE_NEWNET yields the needed caps inside the new ns — valid bypass per audit criteria.

environment_notes.compat_kconfig: CONFIG_COMPAT def_bool y when IA32_EMULATION on x86_64
environment_notes.packet_socket: CONFIG_PACKET tristate — enabled on virtually all distro kernels
environment_notes.iscsi: Attack needs scsi_transport_iscsi registered; no userns required
environment_notes.sixpack: CONFIG_SIXPACK modular/optional; needs ldisc attach (autoload or preloaded)
